rec.name: Highlighted Search Bar with Predictive Search Drawer
rec.status: Built — launched (tested by Christoph and Chris, KVA approved; documentation partly incomplete)

what.text: A standalone Shopify section called "Search function" that makes on-site search more prominent. Variant 1 leaves the search as a plain header icon (magnifier next to the burger menu, as on HNDS). Variant 2 shows a visible search bar under the header, with a grey background band, a coloured rounded border, a placeholder (e.g. "Wonach suchst Du?") and a magnifier icon on the right (as on dermalogica.de). The bar can optionally be sticky. Tapping it opens a custom right-hand predictive search drawer. The drawer has a title, input, live results for products, collections, pages and articles in tabs, and a "View all results" button that goes to /search?q=.

why.text: A visible search field lowers the effort needed to find a product. Shoppers who know what they want (high-intent) get a direct route to it instead of hunting for a small icon. A sticky bar keeps this path available during scrolling. Live product suggestions with image and price shorten the path to the PDP and cut dead-end browsing. The placeholder phrased as a question ("What are you looking for?") invites interaction.

how.text: 1) Create a dedicated section ("Suchfunktion") with a "Highlight" setting: not highlighted (icon only) or highlighted (full-width bar). 2) When highlighted, expose settings for background colour, border colour, placeholder text and a sticky toggle. 3) Because the theme's built-in search drawer is spread across several files and is not portable, build a self-contained snippet (psy-search.liquid) with its own markup, CSS and JS. The snippet includes a fixed full-screen overlay, a right-aligned drawer (max 500px, full width on mobile), a header with close button, an input with a submit icon, hidden tabs (products/collections/pages/articles) and a results area. 4) The JS debounces input (300ms) and calls /search/suggest.json with resources[type]=product,collection,page,article, limit 5 and unavailable products hidden. It renders results (2-column product grid on mobile), aborts stale requests, shows empty/loading/error strings, and formats money with the theme's currency format. Enter, the magnifier or the "View all results" button redirects to /search?q=. 5) Test in the dedicated "Search functionality" theme.

items: Highlight: off (icon only) / on (visible search bar)
Background colour of the search bar (e.g. grey)
Border colour of the search bar (e.g. blue)
Hard-coded in snippet (should be made configurable): drawer title, "view all" button text, UI strings, debounce time, results limit (5), image sizes

dependencies.text: Shopify Predictive Search API (/search/suggest.json). The snippet relies on theme globals window.themeVariables.settings (moneyFormat, moneyWithCurrencyFormat, currencyCodeEnabled), so it is tied to a theme exposing these, and money formatting needs adapting for other themes. No metafields needed (ticket field: MF/N). The existing theme search drawer is not reused. Strings are German and hard-coded in the code file. The code file is truncated, so the section's schema and the sticky implementation are not visible.

items: Search usage rate (sessions using search / total sessions)
Conversion rate of searching vs non-searching sessions
Share of searches ending in the full results page

images.caption: Variant 1 – not highlighted: search shown only as a magnifier icon next to the burger menu in the header (HNDS example)
Variant 2 – highlighted: grey band under the header with a rounded blue-bordered search field, placeholder "Wonach suchst Du?" and magnifier icon (dermalogica.de reference)
